Development Environment

  • Ubunt 18.04.1

  • Architecture : aarch64 (ARMv8)

  • Kernel : 5.4.0

💡

  1. Agent를 ARMv8 용으로 compile하고, 2)agent가 실행되는 device를 IoT thing으로 등록 및 FleetWise 연결에 필요한 MQTT Topic을 등록, 3) Agent를 서비스로 구동

Instance Build

  • Get CloudFormation Template

    • https://aws-iot-fleetwise.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/latest/cfn-templates/fwdev.yml
    • fwdev.yml

Download agent code

  • Working directory
  • Copy Agent code from S3 and unzip

Install Agent dependencies

Dependent Libraries

  • Install Package

    • unzip, git, wget, curl,

    • cmake, libssl-dev, libboost-system-dev, libboost-log-dev, libboost-thread-dev, buildessential, zlib1g-dev, libsnappy-dev, defaultjre, libasio-dev

    • jsoncpp, protobuf, aws-iot-device-sdkcpp-v2

    • Run Install script

SocketCAN

  • CAN : Message protocol designed for vehicles (Rober Bosch GmbH create)

  • SocketCAN : Open source for CAN drivers, network stack (Volkswagen contribution)

  • Git repository for CAN ISO-TP kernel module

    • CAN Transport Protocol : support P2P communication between CAN module

    • https://github.com/hartkopp/can-isotp.git

  • Install package

    • build-essential, dkms, canutils, git linux-modules-extra-uname -r.

  • Run Install script

  • Install result

    • Virtual CAN interface

CAN Simulator

  • CANSIM files

    • canigen.py

    • cansim.py

    • obd_config.json

    • run-cansim.sh

      • CAN signal : vcan0 → forward frames to other bus (cangw)

      • OBD server is performed on every channel

      • Start can simulator command

  • can-utils

    • Userspace utilities and tools for Linux SocketCAN subsystem

    • CAN traffic : candump, canplyaer, cansend, cangen, cansniffer

    • CAN access via IP socket : canlogserver, bcmserver, socketcand

    • CAN in-kernel gateway config : cangw

    • CAN bus mgmt & test : canbusload, can-calc-bit-timing, canfdtest

    • ISO-TP (ISO 15765-2 2016) tool : isotpsend, isotprecv, isotpsniffer, isotpdump, isotpserver, isotpperf, isoptun

    • CAN log file converter : asc2log, log2asc, log2long

    • CAN serial line discipline config : slcan_attach, slcand, slcanpty

    • SAE J1939 tools & demo : jacd, jspy, jsr, testj1939

  • Install package

    • wrapt, cantools, prompt_toolkit, python-can, can-isotp, matplotlib

  • Run install script

  • Install result

Compile Edge Agent

  • Run compile script

  • Compile output

    • ./build/src/executionmanagement/aws-iot-fleetwise-edge

Run Edge Agent

Provision device as AWS IoT Thing

  • Device 설정 : /tools/provision.sh

Register IoT Things

  • Make config directory

  • Run provision script

    • 고유한 vehicle-id 지정
  • Result

  • AWS Console

    • Vehicle ID로 등록 됨

FleetWise Connection Setup

  • Run script

    • config file 위치 지정 : static-config.json

      • vcan0 IF 1 : CAN 2.0A

      • vcan0 IF 2 : OBD J1979

      • CAN buffer : dtc 100 bytes, CAN 10K bytes, Signal decode : 10K bytes, raw CAN Frame : 10K

      • MQTT connection

        • canDataTopic : $aws/iotfleetwise/vehicles/VEHICLE_ID_GOES_HERE/signals

        • checkinTopic : $aws/iotfleetwise/vehicles/VEHICLE_ID_GOES_HERE/checkins

    • IoT Thing으로 등록한 이름을 vehicle-id로 사용 : vehicle-id.txt

    • IoT Core endpoint 지정

    • can bus interface name을 지정 : vcan0

  • Output configuration file

    • /etc/aws-iot-fleetwise/config-0.json

Run Edge Agent

  • FLEET 구성

    • /etc/aws-iot-fleetwise 폴더에 구성된 config.json 파일 개수로 구성

      • default : config-0.json
